استحمرت (form X)
# اِسْتَحْمَرْتُ (istaḥmartu) /is.taħ.mar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
# اِسْتَحْمَرْتَ (istaḥmarta) /is.taħ.mar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
# اِسْتَحْمَرْتِ (istaḥmarti) /is.taħ.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
# اِسْتَحْمَرَتْ (istaḥmarat) /is.t
